alex.s: Heads-up — need concise SIG/CAIQ answers on encryption/KMS/HSM + key rotation for ACME PoC. Vendor risk asked for a short writeup and config snippets by EOD Friday.

tara_sales: Can we reuse the template we sent to BetaCorp last quarter? saves time.

priya_sec: We have a template but will tailor. Key bullets to include: AES-256 at rest, TLS1.2+ (PFS) in transit, supported KMS integrations (Redwood-managed, customer-managed BYOK via CloudKMS/HSM), and HSM-backed keys for Private deployments. Also clarify rotation semantics.

priya_sec: ```Answer excerpt: Data at rest is encrypted using AES-256-GCM. In-transit uses TLS 1.2+ with forward secrecy. Customers may bring keys (BYOK) via supported cloud KMS providers or HSM import. For customers needing hardware protections we support HSM-backed key material (FIPS 140-2/3 compliant options) and can integrate with on-prem key proxies. Key rotation: data-encryption keys are rotated transparently by the platform; customer master keys (CMKs) remain under customer control and can be rotated on their schedule with aliasing to avoid downtime.```

eng-ryan: For the PoC if they request HSM-backed keys I'll stand up a Dedicated pool and walk through the KMS flow. Need 48h to prep a small demo environment and sample playbook.

alex.s: @priya_sec please add one-liner on audit logs / observability (who gets KMS events, retention options). Also include the expected latency impact (negligible for key checks, typical token latency unaffected).

priya_sec: Added: "All KMS operations are logged. For BYOK, we can stream KMS and keystore events to the customer's audit destination (CloudTrail, SIEM ingestion) with configurable retention and export. Key usage metrics are surfaced in Redwood Console per-model/per-route"

sec-bot: Document uploaded: https://redwood-internal.s3/poc/1800456789-kms-qa.pdf :white_check_mark: (permissions set to org-internal + ACME shared link)

tara_sales: Nice. I'll attach this to the SIG/CAIQ answers and flag the risk review ticket. I told ACME we can demo HSM flow in 48-72h. :thumbsup:

alex.s: Sweet — filing final copy into JIRA-4321 and marking pre-sales blocker as resolved once demo slot scheduled. Thanks all.
